question: How many customers placed their first order more than 30 days after they signed up?
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_ts) AS first_ts FROM analytics.orders_v GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f JOIN analytics.customers_v c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE f.first_ts::date - c.signup_date > 30
gold_sql_alt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers_v c WHERE (SELECT MIN(o.order_ts) FROM analytics.orders_v o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)::date - c.signup_date > 30
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: What share of total revenue does each sales channel contribute? Show the channel, its revenue and its percentage.
gold_sql: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM analytics.order_items_v oi JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY o.channel) SELECT channel, revenue, 100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER () AS share_pct FROM ch ORDER BY channel
gold_sql_alt: WITH ch AS (SELECT ord.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - ord.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM analytics.orders_v ord JOIN analytics.order_items_v oi ON oi.order_id = ord.order_id WHERE ord.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY ord.channel) SELECT channel, revenue, 100.0 * revenue / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM ch) AS share_pct FROM ch ORDER BY channel
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: What is the typical (median) time to resolve a closed ticket, in whole calendar days between its opening and closing dates?
gold_sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closed_at::date - opened_at::date) FROM analytics.support_tickets_v WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
gold_sql_alt: WITH d AS (SELECT closed_at::date - opened_at::date AS days FROM analytics.support_tickets_v WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM d) SELECT AVG(days) * 1.0 FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: How many customers placed at least one order in 2025 and at least one order in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers_v c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.orders_v o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-01-01') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.orders_v o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2027-01-01')
gold_sql_alt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM analytics.orders_v WHERE order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts < DATE '2026-01-01') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01') > 0) t
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: On average, how many days pass between an order and a refund on it?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(r.refunded_at::date - o.order_ts::date) FROM analytics.refunds_v r JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
gold_sql_alt: SELECT SUM(r.refunded_at::date - (SELECT o.order_ts::date FROM analytics.orders_v o WHERE o.order_id = r.order_id)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM analytics.refunds_v r
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: Which 5 products earned the most gross margin across all order lines, using each line's unit_price (before any order discount) less the product's unit cost? Show the product name and the margin.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS margin FROM analytics.order_items_v oi JOIN analytics.products_v p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5
gold_sql_alt: SELECT p.name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - p.unit_cost * SUM(oi.quantity) FROM analytics.order_items_v oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id), 0) AS margin FROM analytics.products_v p ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)

question: What was our net revenue in September 2026?
gold_sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM analytics.order_items_v oi JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), ref AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount), 0) AS f FROM analytics.refunds_v rf JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = rf.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-10-01') SELECT (SELECT * FROM rev) - (SELECT f FROM ref)
gold_sql_alt: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - (SELECT ord.discount_pct FROM analytics.orders_v ord WHERE ord.order_id = oi.order_id) / 100.0)) FROM analytics.order_items_v oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT ord.order_id FROM analytics.orders_v ord WHERE ord.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND ord.order_ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ord.order_ts < DATE '2026-10-01')) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM analytics.refunds_v WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM analytics.orders_v WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND order_ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_ts < DATE '2026-10-01'))
authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)
notes: Assumes refunds are attributed to the month of the ORDER and only to paid/shipped/delivered orders (the glossary entry for net revenue must say so)

question: What was the average order value last month?

question: Which country brings in the most revenue? Show the country and the revenue.

accepted_interpretations.label: by the customer's country
accepted_interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM analytics.order_items_v oi JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN analytics.customers_v c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
accepted_interpretations.gold_sql_alt: WITH by_country AS (SELECT c.country, (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM analytics.orders_v o JOIN analytics.order_items_v oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS rev FROM analytics.customers_v c) SELECT country, SUM(rev) AS revenue FROM by_country GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

accepted_interpretations.label: by shipping country, with GB counted as UK
accepted_interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.shipping_country = 'GB' THEN 'UK' ELSE o.shipping_country END AS country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM analytics.order_items_v oi JOIN analytics.orders_v o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
accepted_interpretations.gold_sql_alt: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.shipping_country AS sc, (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM analytics.order_items_v oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100.0) AS total FROM analytics.orders_v o WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) SELECT CASE WHEN sc = 'GB' THEN 'UK' ELSE sc END AS country, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM per_order GROUP BY CASE WHEN sc = 'GB' THEN 'UK' ELSE sc END ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

authored_by: claude-sonnet-5.5 (two formulations, one session; see notes)
